Lanturn

Water Electric

Johto · Generation 2

Lanturn is a Water/Electric-type Light Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 22.5 kg. It evolves from Chinchou. Its highest base stat is HP (125), with a base stat total of 460.
